subject: QBR scrub playbook + leadership review pack requests
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-10T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR scrub playbook + leadership review pack requests

Team —

As we prep for the Oct QBR I want to lock down a lightweight, repeatable playbook for the pipeline scrub and get the leadership review packs finalized by next Wed (10/14). The goal is to make the manager-level commits accurate so finance can close projections Friday 10/16.

High-level asks:
- Managers: update all commit/commit-pending opportunities to the correct stage + note confidence (High/Med/Low) by Mon 10/12 EOD PT.
- Sales ops (Karthik): provide repo of last-touch activity and delta flags so we can prioritize the scrub.
- Leadership packs (Vivek/Laura): I need the template + one-page executive summary per vertical by Tue 10/13 noon PT.

I've attached a first-draft playbook and a leader pack template — use them as a starting point. Please consider the following minimal checklist for each deal:
  * Account health (support escalations / exec engagement)
  * Next-step plan and owner
  * Required procurement/legal blockers and ETA
  * Probability and commit rationale (1-2 lines)

I'll run a 30-min sync on Tue 10/13 9:00am PT for any clarifying questions. If any account needs an exception (e.g., late procurement docs), flag it to me and include the reason + expected date.

Links: QBR folder -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bq-Redwood-QBR-pack
HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thanks — short and pragmatic here.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Americas Sales
Redwood Inference

+1 on the checklist, Sean. A couple of notes from ops/enablement POV:

- We'll run a validation pass against last quarter's closed-won/closed-lost tags to catch bad stage leaks before managers update. Karthik, can you surface any ops-flagged rows to the scrub sheet?
- For the leadership one-pager, propose this structure: 1) Snapshot (top 5 deals w/commits), 2) Risks & mitigations, 3) Required support (legal/procurement/exec), 4) Ask (what leadership needs to decide).

Also, small ask: can we get one finance contact in the review pack so finance doesn't need to dig? I'll add FinanceOps as 'observer' in the deck.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

All —

Uploaded Leader_Pack_Template.pptx and a sample filled example for the Cloud vertical to the shared QBR folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bq-Redwood-QBR-pack/Cloud

Attachment stubs:
- Leader_Pack_Template.pptx (pptx, 4.2MB)
- QBR_Scrub_Playbook_v1.pdf (pdf, 320KB)

Quick reminders for managers filling packs:
- Keep the exec summary to one slide — highlight 3 bullets: commitment, risk, ask.
- Use the probability banding (H/M/L) from the playbook — avoids artful optimism.
- If you need an exec intro for a customer, ping me and I can craft the note.

I'll join the Tue 10/13 sync to review top-of-funnel asks.

-Marissa

Subject: Re: QBR scrub playbook + leadership review pack requests

Thanks — good progress. A couple of clarifications before the leadership packs are locked: 

1) For every "commit" in the leader pack please include the minimum required artifact to validate the commit (e.g., signed SOW, PO, SOC2 attestation, or confirmed legal/finance owner + ETA). If it's not present, label it as "contingent" and call out the required action.

2) Finance needs a single point of contact listed on each pack (name + email) — if managers don't have one, we'll use FinanceOps. This speeds reconciliation.

3) If any vertical expects >$1M movement vs prior forecast call it out in the summary — we need to prep the investor narrative.

I'll review the Cloud sample and provide notes by Tue 10/13 11am PT.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
